title: Add a working contact form to the marketing site
description: Implement a contact form on the marketing site that validates input, sends submissions to the team, and is deployed to the live site. Submit a GitHub pull request or commit link with the change and a short write-up of your approach.

requirements.description: A contact form is implemented and reachable at a live URL.
Form submissions are validated (required fields, email format) before sending.
A GitHub pull request or commit link is provided for the code change.
A brief write-up of the approach taken is included.
